overview: This Senate resolution designates June 2025 as 'Great Outdoors Month.' It notes that hundreds of millions of Americans take part in outdoor recreation each year, and cites federal Commerce Department figures showing that outdoor recreation produced about $1.2 trillion in economic activity in 2023 and supports millions of jobs. It points to the importance of outdoor recreation businesses to rural communities and the value of time outdoors for health. The resolution encourages everyone to enjoy the outdoors responsibly during June and year-round. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on June 16, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution highlights the health benefits and economic importance of outdoor recreation, especially for rural communities.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending on parks, public lands, or access to the outdoors.
